description: This file defines a class 'CalendarViewSaveSettings' that manages user preferences and settings related to the calendar view in the SuiteCRM platform. It handles processing user input from form submissions, updating user preferences such as start/end times, display options, and then redirects to the calendar index view.

classes.name: CalendarViewSaveSettings
classes.description: A view class extending SugarView, responsible for saving calendar display settings based on user input.

methods.name: CalendarViewSaveSettings
methods.description: Constructor method for the class, calls parent constructor.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the request processing; currently invokes the display method.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Saves user preferences based on request data and redirects to the calendar index page.

methods.name: to_db_time
methods.description: Converts hours, minutes, and meridiem into a 24-hour time string.
